Tao ap luc qua tang se bi huy neu khong dong phi trong vong 24 gio.
tactics: Bay trung thuong ao
Doi phi truoc ba truoc
Gia mao giay chung nhan co dau do
whatScammersAskFor: Chuyen tien thue thu nhap ca nhan 10%, phi ho so, phi van chuyen xe may.
Gui ma the cao dien thoai.
howToVerify: Cac chuong trinh khuyen mai trung thuong hop phap deu phai dang ky voi So Cong Thuong va thue duoc tru thang vao gia tri giai thuong.
Khong co don vi uy tin nao bat nguoi trung thuong phai chuyển tiền nop phi truoc.
countermeasures: Bo qua moi thong bao trung thuong tu cac nguon khong ro rang.
whatToDoIfTargeted: Xoa tin nhắn, chan so va khong phan hoi.
whatToDoIfCompromised: Luu lai bang chung tin nhắn va so tài khoản de trinh bao co quan dieu tra.
howItWorks_en: Victims receive SMS, Messenger, or phone notifications claiming they won a motorbike, iPhone, or 100M VND cash.
To receive the prize, victims must pay advance registration fees, personal income taxes, or transport fees.
Scammers provide a personal bank account for payment.
After receiving the fee, scammers demand additional fees or block the victim entirely.
warningSigns_en: Winning a contest or raffle that you never entered or registered for.
Requirement to pay upfront money before receiving prize rewards.
Prize notifications sent from unofficial social media profiles or personal phone numbers.
whatScammersAskFor_en: Upfront money transfers for taxes, shipping, or registration fees.
Personal ID photos and bank account numbers.
howToVerify_en: Under Vietnamese law, prize taxes for winnings over 10M VND are deducted directly from the prize value, NEVER collected upfront via personal transfers.
Verify promotions on official company websites.
countermeasures_en: Ignore prize notices for contests you did not voluntarily join.
Never send advance money to claim any prize.
whatToDoIfTargeted_en: Block the sender and delete the scam message.
Do not provide identity documents or bank details.
whatToDoIfCompromised_en: Gather transaction proofs and submit them to law enforcement.
Warn friends and family about the scam page.

title: 20. Lừa Đảo Gửi Bưu Phẩm Quà Tặng Thu Phí Ship COD Giá Trị Cao
title_en: 20. Fake Parcel COD Shipping Scam Demanding High Fees for Worthless Goods
shortDescription: Lấy trộm thông tin mua hàng trên livestream, gửi gói hàng rác (vỏ hộp, giẻ lau) đến nhà người thân nạn nhân với số tiền thu hộ COD cao.
shortDescription_en: Sending unsolicited low-value packages with high Cash-on-Delivery (COD) fees when victims or family members are unaware of package orders.
whatIsIt: Tội phạm quét thông tin khách hàng bình luận số điện thoại, địa chỉ trên các phiên livestream bán hàng, gửi gói hàng rác (vỏ hộp, giẻ lau) với số tiền thu hộ COD cao.
whatIsIt_en: Scammers obtain leak customer address details, sending cheap low-quality items via shipping couriers with expensive COD fee collection, taking advantage of victims' habit of paying for family members' deliveries.
howItWorks: Kẻ lừa đảo thu thap thong tin don hang that cua nan nhan tren mang xa hoi.
Tao don hang gia qua cac cong ty chuyen phat nhanh (GHTK, GHN, Viettel Post, J&T).
Shipper giao hang toi nha khi nan nhan vang nha, goi dien cho nguoi nha hoac bao nan nhan chuyển khoản ngân hàng truoc de shipper gui bao ve.
Mo hop ra chi co giay vun, khau trang cu hoac hang gia vo gia tri.
warningSigns: Giao kien hang ma ban khong he dat mua hoac khong nho da mua mon gi.
Shipper giuc chuyển khoản ngân hàng thanh toan gap de chay don tiep.
Nguoi ban tu choi cho VND kiem (xem hang truoc khi nhan).
redFlags: Thong tin nguoi gui tren buu pham khong ro rang hoac de ten shop map mo.
psychologicalTactics: Loi dung thoi quen mua sam online nhieu cua nguoi dan khien ho khong nho het cac don hang.
Loi dung su tin tuong cua relative nhan ho o nha.
tactics: Quet trom du lieu Livestream
Giao hang rac thu COD
Loi dung relative nhan ho
whatScammersAskFor: Tien mat thu ho COD tu 100.000d den vai million VND.
howToVerify: Kiem tra ma van don tren ứng dụng mua sam chinh thuc (Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop).
Yeu cau mo hop VND kiem truoc su chung kien cua nhan vien giao hang.
countermeasures: Dan do nguoi nha tuyet doi khong nhan va thanh toan bat ky don hang nao neu chua co su VND y cua ban.
An thong tin so dien thoai khi binh luan tren cac phien livestream ban hang.
whatToDoIfTargeted: Tu choi nhan hang va yeu cau hoan tra nguoi gui.
whatToDoIfCompromised: Bao cao ngay voi don vi van chuyen de giu lai tien COD chua quyet toan cho ke lua dao.
howItWorks_en: A delivery driver arrives at the victim's house delivering a package with COD fee (e.g., 300,000 to 900,000 VND).
The courier claims the package was ordered by a family member currently away or busy.
The victim pays the COD fee and accepts the delivery.
Upon opening, the box contains junk, paper, or worthless items.
warningSigns_en: Packages delivered unexpectedly without prior order confirmation in e-commerce apps.
Delivery label lacks clear seller info, product itemization, or official tracking code.
Courier pressures rapid payment without allowing inspection.
whatScammersAskFor_en: Cash or bank transfer payment for fake COD package deliveries.
howToVerify_en: Always check active order histories on Shopee, Lazada, or TikTok Shop apps before accepting COD packages.
Call family members directly to confirm if they actually placed the order.
countermeasures_en: Refuse delivery of any unverified COD packages.
Instruct family members never to pay for unknown parcels.
whatToDoIfTargeted_en: Reject package acceptance and inform the delivery driver of unverified order.
Report fraudulent delivery shop info to the shipping carrier.
whatToDoIfCompromised_en: Contact shipping company hotline to flag fraudulent seller details.
Blacklist the shipping sender phone number.

title: 21. Dụ Dỗ Quét Mã QR Nhận Quà / Thanh Toán Dẫn Tới Link Giả Mạo (Quishing)
title_en: 21. Malicious QR Code Scan Lead to Fake Phishing Portals (Quishing)
shortDescription: Dán đè mã QR lừa đảo tại các cửa hàng, hoặc gửi mã QR 'nhận tiền hoàn cước' chứa liên kết độc hại đánh cắp tài khoản ngân hàng.
shortDescription_en: Replacing legitimate QR codes at public payment spots or sending fake gift QR codes to trick victims into scanning and entering credentials on phishing websites.
whatIsIt: Quishing (QR Phishing) là thủ đoạn lợi dụng sự tiện lợi của mã QR để che giấu liên kết lừa đảo. Kẻ gian dán đè mã QR lừa đảo tại quầy thanh toán hoặc gửi mã QR giả qua tin nhắn.
whatIsIt_en: Quishing involves manipulating QR codes placed on restaurant counters, parking tickets, or public flyers, redirecting users to fake banking login portals or malicious APK downloads.
howItWorks: Kẻ lừa đảo dan de ma QR nhan tien cua minh len bang ma QR thanh toan tai cac quay thu ngan quan an, cua hang.
Hoac gui ma QR qua tin nhắn bao: "Quet ma nay de nhan tien thuong 500k tri an khach hang".
Khi quet ma bang camera dien thoai hoac Zalo, website mo ra yeu cau dang nhap tài khoản ngân hàng hoac cap quyen truy cap Zalo.
warningSigns: Ma QR tai quay thanh toan co dau hieu bi dan de, meo mo hoac lech goc.
Quet ma QR xong xuat hien link website co duoi la yeu cau nhap password.
Yeu cau quet ma QR de "nhan tien ve tài khoản" (Nhan tien chi can cung cap so tài khoản, khong bao gio phai quet ma).
redFlags: Ma QR yeu cau cap quyen dang nhap Zalo/Telegram tren may tinh la.
psychologicalTactics: Loi dung su tien loi va thoi quen quet ma QR nhanh chong cua nguoi dung hien dai.
Tinh chat an danh cua ma QR (khong nhin thay URL truc tiep truoc khi quet).
tactics: Dan de ma QR tai diem ban vat ly
Gui ma QR chiem quyen Zalo
Trang web Phishing giau sau QR
whatScammersAskFor: Chuyen tien mua hang vao tài khoản ke gian thay vi chu quan.
Xac thuc dang nhap tài khoản Zalo/Ngan hang.
howToVerify: Khi quet ma thanh toan, luon check ten chu tài khoản thu huong hien thi tren ứng dụng xem co dung ten chu cua hang khong.
Nhin ky xem ma QR co bi dan de lop giay moi len tren khong.
countermeasures: Kiem tra ky URL truoc khi bam "Mo lien ket" sau khi quet ma QR.
Tuyet doi khong quet ma QR la de dang nhap tài khoản tren cac thiet bi khong phai cua minh.
whatToDoIfTargeted: Tat website ngay, khong bam VND y cap quyen.
Bao cho chu quan neu phat hien bang ma QR bi dan de.
whatToDoIfCompromised: Mo Zalo/Ngan hang vao phan Quan ly thiet bi dang nhap, lap tuc bam "Dang xuat khoi tat ca cac thiet bi khac".
howItWorks_en: Scammers paste fraudulent QR stickers over authentic store payment QR codes.
When customers scan to pay, money is routed to the scammer's bank account instead of the shop.
Alternatively, QR codes sent in chat messages lead to fake bank portals harvesting OTPs and credentials.
warningSigns_en: QR code stickers showing signs of physical tampering or overlapping layers.
Scanning a payment QR opens a web browser link instead of directly opening the official banking app.
Websites asking for full banking passwords, PINs, or OTPs after QR scanning.
whatScammersAskFor_en: Direct payment transfers to fraudulent receiver accounts.
Bank login credentials and OTP verification codes.
howToVerify_en: Verify the recipient account name carefully on the banking app screen before authorizing payment.
Ensure payment scans open natively inside official banking apps rather than web browser popups.
countermeasures_en: Double-check recipient name with store clerks before hitting transfer confirm.
Avoid scanning random QR codes on public flyers offering free gifts or promotions.
whatToDoIfTargeted_en: Cancel payment immediately if recipient name doesn't match the merchant.
Alert store management about tampered QR stickers.
whatToDoIfCompromised_en: Immediately reset banking passwords and lock online banking access.
Report unauthorized payments to bank customer service.

title: 22. Lừa Nâng Cấp SIM 4G/5G Từ Xa Chiếm Đoạt Quyền Sử Dụng SIM (SIM Swap)
title_en: 22. Remote SIM 4G/5G Upgrade Scam Hijacking Phone Number (SIM Swap)
shortDescription: Tự xưng nhân viên nhà mạng hỗ trợ đổi SIM 4G lên 5G miễn phí không cần ra quầy, hướng dẫn nhắn tin cú pháp SMS để cướp quyền kiểm soát SIM.
shortDescription_en: Impersonating telecom operators offering free 4G/5G SIM upgrades, tricking victims into sending SIM swap codes to steal phone numbers and intercept banking OTPs.
whatIsIt: Tấn công hoàn đổi SIM (SIM Swap Fraud). Kẻ gian dụ dỗ nạn nhân nhắn tin cú pháp ủy quyền đổi SIM từ xa để chiếm đoạt số điện thoại và nhận mã OTP ngân hàng.
whatIsIt_en: Scammers trick mobile subscribers into performing SMS syntax operations that transfer ownership of their SIM card to the scammer's blank SIM, allowing them to steal SMS OTPs and breach bank accounts.
howItWorks: Kẻ lừa đảo goi dien mao danh nhan vien Viettel, MobiFone, VinaPhone thong bao SIM ban dang dung sap bi cat do chua nang cap len 4G/5G.
Huong dan cu phap nhan tin: Soan `SIM... [Day so serial phoi SIM cua ke gian]` gui `901` hoac `1414`.
Ngay sau khi gui tin nhắn, SIM tren dien thoai nan nhan bi mat song hoan toan (No Service).
Kẻ lừa đảo lap SIM moi vao may cua chung, nhan mã OTP bank va doi password, rut sach tien.
warningSigns: Nhan vien nha mang yeu cau nhan tin cu phap la co chua day so dai gui tong dai.
Dien thoai dot ngot bi mat song hoan toan, khong the goi hay nhan tin nhắn trong khi xung quanh van co song.
Yeu cau nang cap SIM ma khong can den cua hang giao dich truc tiep.
redFlags: Tin nhan phan hoi cua nha mang co noi dung: "Quy khach dang yeu cau doi SIM moi...".
psychologicalTactics: Tao su thuan tien (doi SIM mien phi tai nha khong can di lai) de thu hut nguoi dung.
De doa se bi khoa SIM neu khong nang cap len 5G kip thoi.
tactics: Lua gui cu phap doi phoi SIM
Cuop quyen nhan mã OTP SMS
Rut tien tài khoản ngân hàng
whatScammersAskFor: Nhan tin cu phap doi so serial phoi SIM trang gui tong dai nha mang.
howToVerify: Nha mang KHONG BAO GIO ho tro doi SIM tu xa qua tin nhắn dien thoai.
Viec doi SIM 4G/5G bat buoc phai thuc hien truc tiep tai cua hang giao dich chinh thuc cua nha mang co xuat trinh CCCD chinh chu.
countermeasures: Khong soan tin nhắn theo bat ky cu phap nao do nguoi la huong dan qua dien thoai.
Neu thay SIM dot ngot mat song bat thuong, phai muon may khac goi ngay tong dai nha mang de check trang thai SIM.
whatToDoIfTargeted: Tu choi va dap may ngay.
whatToDoIfCompromised: Dung may khac goi tong dai nha mang KHOA SIM KHAN CAP ngay lap tuc.
Goi tong dai cac bank ban dang dung de KHOA TAI KHOAN TRUOC KHI ke gian kip nhan OTP.
howItWorks_en: Scammers call victims posing as Viettel, VinaPhone, or MobiFone customer service offering free 4G/5G SIM upgrades.
They instruct victims to send specific SMS commands (e.g. SIM swap codes) on their phone.
Once sent, the victim's SIM loses signal immediately.
Scammers take control of the phone number, request password resets on banking apps, and intercept OTPs to drain funds.
warningSigns_en: Calls offering remote SIM upgrades requiring specific SMS syntax inputs.
Loss of mobile network signal immediately after following phone instructions.
Receiving password reset alerts for email or banking accounts.
whatScammersAskFor_en: Sending specific SMS syntax codes containing SIM serial numbers.
OTP codes or personal identification numbers.
howToVerify_en: Telecom operators NEVER perform SIM card upgrades remotely via phone instructions without physical SIM distribution.
Visit official telecom service centers in person for SIM upgrades.
countermeasures_en: Never compose or send SMS syntax requested by unknown phone callers.
Set up biometric or authenticator app security instead of relying solely on SMS OTPs.
whatToDoIfTargeted_en: Refuse any remote SIM upgrade instructions and hang up.
Contact your mobile network operator's official hotline immediately.
whatToDoIfCompromised_en: Contact mobile network operator immediately to lock the SIM card.
Notify bank hotline urgently to lock all online banking services.

title: 23. Lừa Đảo 'Chạy Ấn', Xin Việc Làm, Làm Visa Xuất Khẩu Lao Động Ảo
title_en: 23. Fake Job Placement, Overseas Visa Brokerage & Bribery Fraud
shortDescription: Tự nhận có 'quan hệ rộng' chạy trắng án, xin việc vào cơ quan nhà nước hoặc làm thủ tục xuất khẩu lao động sang Hàn/Nhật rồi ôm tiền cọc bỏ trốn.
shortDescription_en: Promising guaranteed government job placements, overseas labor visas, or illegal lawsuit resolutions, collecting massive upfront bribe fees before disappearing.
whatIsIt: Kẻ lừa đảo khoe khoang có mối quan hệ thân thiết với lãnh đạo cấp cao, cam kết xin việc làm vào cơ quan nhà nước hoặc làm thủ tục xuất khẩu lao động rồi ôm tiền cọc bỏ trốn.
whatIsIt_en: Scammers pretend to have high-level connections in government agencies, embassies, or labor export firms, taking money from job seekers or visa applicants under the guise of illegal 'expediting fees'.
howItWorks: Tiep can gia dinh co relative dang bi tam giam hoac nguoi dang can xin viec, di xuat khau lao dong.
Chup anh cung nguoi noi tieng, mac vest sang trong, khoe giay to gia mao de tao long tin.
Ky hop VND "tu van dich vu" bang giay viet tay hoac cam ket mieng.
Yeu cau nop tien theo tung giai doan: Phi boi tron, phi nop ho so mat, phi tham dinh...
Den ngay hen thi tat dien thoai, xoa tài khoản mang xa hoi va bo tron.
warningSigns: Cam ket "chay an", "xin viec bien che", "visa bao dau 100%" trai quy dinh phap luat.
Yeu cau dua tien mat hoac chuyển khoản ngân hàng ca nhan khong co hoa don chung tu hop le.
Yeu cau giu bi mat tuyet doi khong duoc hoi tham co quan chuc nang.
redFlags: Khong co tru so cong ty ro rang hoac cong ty khong co giay phep hoat dong dich vu viec lam/xuat khau lao dong cua Bo LD-TB&XH.
psychologicalTactics: Loi dung tam ly non nong, su be tac va ca tin cua nguoi nha nan nhan.
Danh vao su e ngai phap luat cua nan nhan (nan nhan ngai bao police vi ban than cung tham gia hanh vi "chay chot").
tactics: Khoe khoang quan he ao
Cam ket bao dau 100%
Nhan tien coc nhieu dot
whatScammersAskFor: Tien mat hoac chuyển khoản ngân hàng tien coc tu 50 million den hang ty VND.
howToVerify: Phap luat Viet Nam nghiem cam moi hanh vi dua hoi lo, chay an, xin viec chay chot (day la hanh vi vi pham hinh su).
Tra cuu danh sach doanh nghiep xuat khau lao dong duoc cap phep tai Cong thong tin Cuc Quan ly lao dong ngoai nuoc (`dolab.gov.vn`).
countermeasures: Tuyet doi khong tin cac dich vu "chay an" hay "xin viec cua sau".
Lam thu tuc xin visa, du hoc, xuat khau lao dong qua cac trung tam uy tin duoc cap phep.
whatToDoIfTargeted: Tu choi giao dich va to giac doi tuong toi co quan police.
whatToDoIfCompromised: Tap hop toan bo giay to cam ket, ghi am cuộc gọi, sao ke chuyển khoản ngân hàng nop don to cao tai Co quan Canh sat dieu tra.
howItWorks_en: Scammers pose as influential brokers capable of securing prestigious jobs or work visas to Korea, Japan, or Europe.
They demand upfront processing fees, deposit guarantees, or bribery fees.
They issue fake commitment letters or forged visa approval documents.
Once full payment is collected, scammers disappear or sever all communication.
warningSigns_en: Promises of guaranteed employment or visa approvals without official interviews or skills testing.
Demanding payments off-the-books into personal bank accounts.
Lack of official labor export license verified by the Ministry of Labor, Invalids and Social Affairs (MOLISA).
whatScammersAskFor_en: Large cash or bank transfer payments for processing and expediting fees.
Original passports, identity cards, and academic certificates.
howToVerify_en: Check licensed labor export agencies on the Department of Overseas Labour (DOLAB) portal.
Apply for visas directly through official embassy/consulate application centers.
countermeasures_en: Never pay money to unofficial brokers claiming backdoor influence.
Rely only on legally accredited labor export enterprises.
whatToDoIfTargeted_en: Refuse all informal payment demands and demand official corporate documentation.
Report fraudulent brokers to police authorities.
whatToDoIfCompromised_en: Collect all receipts, contracts, and chat logs for criminal reporting.
File a formal report with local police.

title: 24. Dịch Vụ Hỗ Trợ 'Lấy Lại Tiền Bị Lừa Đảo' (Treo Đầu Dê Bán Thịt Chó)
title_en: 24. Fake Scam Recovery Services & Cyber Lawyer Fraud (Double Trap)
category: Lừa đảo Kép & Thu hồi vốn ảo
shortDescription: Mạo danh Văn phòng Luật sư, Cục An ninh mạng cam kết lấy lại 100% tiền đã bị lừa, dụ nạn nhân nộp thêm 'phí phần mềm' để tiếp tục lừa lần 2.
shortDescription_en: Posing as cybersecurity experts, IT specialists, or lawyers offering to 'hack back' and recover lost scam funds, coercing victims into paying secondary recovery fees.
whatIsIt: Lừa đảo kép (Recovery Scam). Tội phạm nhắm vào những người vừa bị lừa đảo mất tiền, mạo danh Văn phòng Luật sư cam kết lấy lại tiền rồi yêu cầu nộp phí phần mềm thu hồi.
whatIsIt_en: Scammers target people who have already lost money to previous scams, pretending to be cyber police or IT recovery experts who can trace and recover stolen funds for a fee.
howItWorks: Lap cac Fanpage Facebook co ten: "Cuc An Ninh Mang Ho Tro Thu Hoi Von Treo", "Van Phong Luat Su Tranh Tung"... chay quang cao ram ro.
Nạn nhân gui thong tin vu viec va so tien da mat.
Kẻ lừa đảo dung tài khoản ao gui anh chup man hinh gia mao: "Da phong toa thanh cong so tien 200 million cua ban tren cong thanh toan quoc te".
Yeu cau nan nhan chuyen 10-20% phi mo cong giai ngan (VD: 20 million) de rut tien ve.
Nhan xong 20 million, ke gian tiep tuc voi them tien roi chan lien lac (nan nhan bi lua 2 lan lien tiep).
warningSigns: Quang cao dich vu "thu hoi tien lua dao", "hack tài khoản san ao lay lai tien" tren Facebook/TikTok.
Yeu cau nop tien phi uy thac, phi phan mem keo tien truoc.
Co quan police khong bao gio thu tien phi ho tro nguoi dan lay lai tai san bi chiem doat.
redFlags: Su dung tài khoản ngân hàng ca nhan de nhan tien phi "thu hoi tai san".
psychologicalTactics: Danh vao tam ly tuyet vong va khat khao lay lai so tien da mat cua nan nhan.
Muon danh co quan phap luat va an ninh mang de tao vo boc tin cay.
tactics: Lua dao lan 2 (Recovery Scam)
Gia mao Cuc An ninh mang A05
Tao bang chung phong toa tien ao
whatScammersAskFor: Chuyen tien phi dich vu luat su, phi giai ngan tai san thu hoi tu 5 million den 50 million VND.
howToVerify: Bo Cong an va Cuc An ninh mang A05 KHONG BAO GIO lap website hay Fanpage thu hoi tien lua dao cho nguoi dan.
Khong co cong nghe hay luat su nao co the "hack he thong san ao de rut tien ve tu dong".
countermeasures: Khi bi lua dao, noi duy nhat tiep nhan va xu ly la Co quan Cong an cap Quan/Huyen/Tinh, hoan toan mien phi.
Tuyet doi khong tim kiem cac dich vu lay lai tien tren mang xa hoi.
whatToDoIfTargeted: Khong lien he, bao cao Fanpage gia mao cho Facebook.
whatToDoIfCompromised: Dung nop tien ngay, den truc tiep tru so Co quan Canh sat dieu tra Cong an dia phuong de lam don to cao.
howItWorks_en: Scammers advertise on Facebook or Telegram claiming a 99% success rate in recovering scammed money.
Victims reach out seeking help to get their lost funds back.
Scammers create fake software interfaces showing 'recovered funds' trapped in holding accounts.
They demand upfront 'reclaiming software fees', 'tax fees', or 'system clearance fees' before releasing money.
warningSigns_en: Services promising guaranteed recovery of funds lost to online scams.
Demanding upfront system software or legal representation fees.
Communicating via personal Zalo/Telegram accounts instead of registered law firm offices.
whatScammersAskFor_en: Upfront recovery fees, software clearance fees, or system commission deposits.
Bank account records and case details of previous scams.
howToVerify_en: No IT specialist or private lawyer can legally access banking backends or forcibly retrieve transferred funds.
Only official state investigative agencies have legal authority to freeze and recover fraudulent assets.
countermeasures_en: Never trust online services claiming they can retrieve scammed money for a fee.
Report all scam incidents directly to the official Police Department.
whatToDoIfTargeted_en: Ignore recovery service advertisements on social media.
Do not transfer any secondary fees.
whatToDoIfCompromised_en: Stop all further financial transfers.
Include the recovery scam details in your official police complaint.

title: 25. Chiếm Đoạt Tài Khoản Telegram Bằng Mã Xác Thực Đăng Nhập Máy Tính
title_en: 25. Telegram Account Takeover via Fake Desktop QR Code Login Verification
category: Mạng xã hội & Chiếm đoạt tài khoản
shortDescription: Gửi link 'bình chọn', 'nhận tài liệu' bắt quét mã QR Telegram hoặc gửi mã OTP xác thực đăng nhập máy tính để chiếm quyền tài khoản Telegram.
shortDescription_en: Tricking Telegram users into scanning desktop web login QR codes under the guise of voting or receiving gifts, hijacking account access to scam contacts.
whatIsIt: Kẻ tấn công tạo website giả mạo yêu cầu quét mã QR để xác thực xem tài liệu hoặc bình chọn cuộc thi, qua đó đăng nhập tài khoản Telegram của nạn nhân trên máy tính.
whatIsIt_en: Scammers build fake contest voting sites or gift links that prompt users to scan a QR code using Telegram, inadvertently authorizing a new desktop session for the scammer.
howItWorks: Kẻ lừa đảo gui tin nhắn qua Telegram: "Xem hinh anh vu tai nan hom qua tai link nay" hoac "Xac minh tài khoản Telegram de khong bi xoa".
Duong link hien ma QR bao: "Mo ứng dụng Telegram quet ma nay de xac minh".
Khi quet ma, thuc chat nan nhan da cho phep thiet bi cua ke gian dang nhap vao tài khoản Telegram cua minh.
Kẻ lừa đảo ngay lap tuc bat password 2 lop (Two-Step Verification) moi, da phien dang nhap cua nan nhan ra khoi dien thoai.
Dung tài khoản Telegram vua chiem de nhan tin vay tien toan bo cac nhom chat tien ao, doi tac kinh doanh.
warningSigns: Yeu cau quet ma QR bang ứng dụng Telegram de "xem tai lieu" hoac "nhan qua".
Nhan duoc tin nhắn tu Telegram chinh thuc gui ma xac nhan dang nhap moi tu dia chi IP la.
Cac thong bao bao mat gui ve dien thoai bang tieng Anh hoac tu vi tri dia ly xa la.
redFlags: App Telegram tren dien thoai dot ngot nhan duoc thong bao "Dang nhap moi tu trinh duyet Linux/Windows...".
psychologicalTactics: Loi dung su to mo va thoi quen quet ma QR khong doc ky canh bao tren man hinh ứng dụng.
tactics: Quet ma QR chiem phien Telegram Web
Khoa tài khoản bang password 2 lop moi
Tong tien danh ba nhom chat
whatScammersAskFor: Quet ma QR dang nhap Telegram.
Gui mã OTP 5 chu so dang nhap Telegram gui ve tin nhắn.
howToVerify: Khi quet ma QR tren Telegram, ứng dụng luon hien thi dong chu: "Ban dang dang nhap Telegram tren thiet bi moi...". Neu khong phai do ban tu mo tren may tinh, tuyet doi bam HUY.
countermeasures: Bat tinh nang Xac thuc 2 buoc (Two-Step Verification / Mat khau dam may) trong Cai dat bao mat cua Telegram.
Thuong xuyen check muc `Settings -> Devices` (Thiet bi) va xoa cac thiet bi la.
whatToDoIfTargeted: Huy quet ma, doi password 2 buoc ngay.
whatToDoIfCompromised: Neu van con phien dang nhap tren dien thoai: Vao `Settings -> Devices -> Terminate all other sessions` (Dang xuat tat ca thiet bi khac) ngay lap tuc.
Thong bao trong cac nhom chat canh bao tài khoản da bi hack.
howItWorks_en: Victims receive messages asking them to vote for a friend's child in a contest or claim a free gift.
The link opens a website displaying a Telegram login QR code.
Victims scan the QR code via Telegram > Settings > Devices.
Scammers gain full active session control, read secret chat logs, and message contacts asking for emergency loans.
warningSigns_en: Voting or promo websites requiring Telegram QR code scanning to verify identity.
Unexpected login notifications for Telegram Desktop sessions from unfamiliar locations.
Friends messaging on Telegram asking for urgent money transfers.
whatScammersAskFor_en: Scanning QR codes via Telegram app settings.
SMS login verification codes or Two-Step Verification passwords.
howToVerify_en: Scanning a QR code in Telegram settings is STRICTLY for logging in new devices, never for online contest voting.
Check active Telegram sessions in Settings > Devices regularly.
countermeasures_en: Enable Two-Step Verification (Passcode) on Telegram.
Never scan Telegram device login QR codes on external websites.
whatToDoIfTargeted_en: Close the fake voting website immediately without scanning.
Warn the friend whose account sent the suspicious link.
whatToDoIfCompromised_en: Go to Telegram Settings > Devices > Terminate All Other Sessions immediately.
Enable Two-Step Verification password right away.

title: 26. Kêu Gọi Từ Thiện Cứu Trợ Thiên Tai Bằng Số Tài Khoản Cánh Nhân Mạo Danh
title_en: 26. Fake Charity & Disaster Relief Donation Account Impersonation Scam
category: Lừa đảo Từ thiện & Đời sống
shortDescription: Lợi dụng bão lũ, thiên tai, bệnh hiểm nghèo để lập Fanpage giả mạo Mặt trận Tổ quốc hoặc cơ quan cứu trợ, đưa số tài khoản cá nhân để trục lợi.
shortDescription_en: Impersonating reputable charity organizations or relief funds during natural disasters, using personal bank accounts to siphon public donations.
whatIsIt: Kẻ lừa đảo lợi dụng lòng nhân ái của người dân trong các đợt bão lũ, thiên tai để lập Fanpage giả mạo Mặt trận Tổ quốc hoặc tổ chức từ thiện, đưa số tài khoản cá nhân để trục lợi.
whatIsIt_en: During floods, storms, or severe accidents, scammers create fake fanpages or personal accounts mimicking Red Cross, relief groups, or victim families to pocket donations.
howItWorks: Khi xay ra thien tai, bao lu lon, ke gian lap tuc tao hang loat fanpage co ten giong Uy ban MTTQ Viet Nam, Hoi Chu Thap Do...
Lay cap hinh anh, bai viet cuu tro that cua cac doan tinh nguyen, bien tap lai loi keu goi khan thiet.
Thay so tài khoản chinh thong bang so tài khoản ca nhan cua ke lua dao (hoac tài khoản co ten gan giong).
Chay quang cao Facebook de tiep can hang million nguoi co long hao tam chuyển tiền ung ho.
warningSigns: Trang keu goi tu thien moi thanh lap vai ngay, co luong tuong tac bat thuong.
So tài khoản nhan tien la tài khoản ca nhan thay vi tài khoản minh bach cua cac to chuc tu thien duoc nha nuoc cap phep.
Khong co bao cao sao ke minh bach cac dot thu chi cuu tro.
redFlags: Fanpage gia mao ten co quan nha nuoc nhung khong co dau tich xanh xác minh.
psychologicalTactics: Danh vao long trac an, su VND cam va tinh than tuong than tuong ai cua VND bao.
Loi dung su nong long muon giup do nan nhan vung lu de nguoi dan khong kip check tài khoản.
tactics: Loi dung bao lu thien tai
Sao chep hinh anh thuong tam
Thay so tài khoản nhan tien tu thien
whatScammersAskFor: Chuyen tien ung ho tu thien tu vai tram nghin den hang million VND vao so tài khoản ca nhan.
howToVerify: Chi gui tien ung ho qua cac so tài khoản chinh thuc cua Ban Cuu tro Trung uong - Uy ban Trung uong Mat tran To quoc Viet Nam hoac Hoi Chu thap do Viet Nam.
Kiem tra ky thong tin don vi tiep nhan tren cac kenh truyen thong chinh thong cua VTV, bao Nhan Dan.
countermeasures: Khong chuyển tiền tu thien vao cac so tài khoản ca nhan troi noi tren mang xa hoi.
whatToDoIfTargeted: Bao cao trang Fanpage gia mao va canh bao cho friend.
whatToDoIfCompromised: Luu vet chuyển tiền va gui phan anh toi co quan police de triet pha duong day truc loi tu thien.
howItWorks_en: Scammers set up Facebook fanpages using logos and images of real charity groups or disaster relief campaigns.
They write emotional posts pleading for urgent financial help for victims.
They list personal bank account numbers with slightly altered beneficiary names.
Donations sent by generous citizens are stolen directly by scammers.
warningSigns_en: Charity callouts listing personal bank accounts instead of registered corporate charity fund accounts.
Unverified fanpages created recently without official blue verification badges.
Copy-pasted emotional content without transparent audit reports.
whatScammersAskFor_en: Direct money transfers to personal bank accounts for charity contributions.
howToVerify_en: Verify official relief fund accounts published on government news outlets or verified organization portals.
Check beneficiary account names carefully before transferring.
countermeasures_en: Donate exclusively through officially recognized organizations such as the Vietnam Fatherland Front or Central Red Cross.
Avoid transferring charity money to unverified personal bank accounts.
whatToDoIfTargeted_en: Verify donation information on official government or news agency channels.
Report fraudulent charity fanpages to Facebook.
whatToDoIfCompromised_en: Notify payment bank of fraudulent account details.
Submit evidence to police cyber defense units.

title: 27. Đặt Cọc Phòng Khách Sạn / Tour Du Lịch Giá Siêu Rẻ Dịp Lễ Rồi Bùng Cọc
title_en: 27. Fake Discount Hotel & Tour Package Deposit Scam during Peak Holidays
shortDescription: Lập Fanpage nhái khách sạn, resort 5 sao nổi tiếng, bán combo phòng giá rẻ hơn thị trường 50%, yêu cầu chuyển tiền cọc rồi chặn liên lạc.
shortDescription_en: Creating fake fanpages of luxury resorts or travel agencies, offering ultra-cheap holiday tour packages, requiring 50-100% upfront deposits before blocking victims.
whatIsIt: Kẻ lừa đảo tạo fanpage mạo danh các khách sạn, khu nghỉ dưỡng (resort) nổi tiếng, bán combo phòng giá rẻ hơn thị trường 50%, yêu cầu chuyển tiền cọc rồi chặn liên lạc.
whatIsIt_en: Scammers take advantage of high travel demand during holidays, setting up cloned fanpages of famous hotels or travel agencies to collect fake booking deposits.
howItWorks: Tao fanpage co ten va anh dai dien giong het resort 5 sao, sao chep toan bo bai dang, video danh gia.
Dang bai thanh ly voucher phong nghi, combo ve may bay + khach san giam gia 50% chi ap dung trong ngay.
Khi khach nhan tin hoi, ke gian tu van nhiet tinh, gui hop VND xac nhan dat phong co con dau gia.
Yeu cau khach chuyển tiền coc hoac thanh toan 100% tien phong vao tài khoản ca nhan de "giu phong gio chot".
Sau khi khach chuyển tiền xong, doi tuong chan Facebook, Zalo, dien thoai.
warningSigns: Gia phong hoac tour re bat thuong so voi mat bang chung cac trang dat phong uy tin (Agoda, Booking.com).
Fanpage moi lap, co nhieu luot thich ao, phan danh gia bi tat.
Yeu cau chuyển tiền coc gap vao so tài khoản ca nhan cua nguoi tu xung la "Quan ly kinh doanh" thay vi tài khoản cong ty khach san.
redFlags: Thuc ep chuyển tiền ngay trong 15 phut voi ly do "chi con 1 phong duy nhat".
psychologicalTactics: Tao tam ly san deal hoi gia re va noi so het phong trong mua du lich cao diem.
tactics: Nhai Fanpage resort 5 sao
Tung deal gia sieu re
Hoi thuc chuyen coc giu cho
whatScammersAskFor: Chuyen khoan tien coc phong tu 2 million den hang chuc million VND.
howToVerify: Tra cuu so dien thoai hotline co dinh cua khach san tren Google Maps hoac website chinh thuc de goi xac nhan.
Dat phong qua cac nen tang OTA uy tin co bao hiem huy phong (Booking.com, Traveloka, Agoda).
countermeasures: Kiem tra tinh minh bach cua Fanpage (ngay doi ten, vi tri nguoi quan tri trang).
Chi chuyển khoản ngân hàng vao tài khoản cong ty co ten doanh nghiep chu quan khach san.
whatToDoIfTargeted: Khong chuyển tiền coc, goi truc tiep khach san de check.
whatToDoIfCompromised: Bao bank va lam don to cao gui Cong an dia phuong noi cu tru.
howItWorks_en: Scammers run sponsored Facebook ads offering 50% discounts on luxury resort vouchers or holiday tour packages.
When victims inquire, scammers send forged booking confirmation vouchers.
They demand 50% to 100% room deposit transfers to secure booking.
Once paid, scammers block communication, leaving victims stranded upon resort arrival.
warningSigns_en: Unbelievably cheap resort or flight ticket prices compared to market averages.
Fanpages lacking official verification badges or registered office addresses.
Demanding payment into personal bank accounts instead of corporate business accounts.
whatScammersAskFor_en: Upfront deposit transfers for hotel rooms or travel vouchers.
Personal guest identity info and travel schedules.
howToVerify_en: Call official resort hotline numbers listed on verified websites to confirm booking availability.
Use accredited travel platforms (Agoda, Booking.com, Traveloka) or licensed travel agencies.
countermeasures_en: Never deposit money to personal bank accounts for hotel bookings.
Cross-verify room availability directly with resort receptionists.
whatToDoIfTargeted_en: Verify resort contacts on official corporate channels.
Report fraudulent travel pages to social media platforms.
whatToDoIfCompromised_en: Keep all messaging histories and payment vouchers for police reporting.
Alert hotel management about the impersonating fanpage.

title: 28. Học Bổng Du Học Quốc Tế 'Bao Đậu' Yêu Cầu Đặt Cọc Giữ Chỗ Khẩn Cấp
title_en: 28. Fake Overseas Study Scholarship Deposit & Visa Guarantee Fraud
shortDescription: Mạo danh đại diện các trường đại học danh tiếng tại Úc, Mỹ, Canada thông báo trúng học bổng 100%, ép phụ huynh nộp phí chứng minh tài chính.
shortDescription_en: Posing as international university representatives offering 100% study abroad scholarships, demanding urgent seat reservation or financial proof deposits.
whatIsIt: Kẻ lừa đảo lập các trung tâm tư vấn du học ảo, gửi thư chúc mừng giả mạo từ các trường đại học danh tiếng tại Úc, Mỹ, Canada để ép phụ huynh nộp tiền cọc giữ chỗ khẩn cấp.
whatIsIt_en: Scammers target students and parents seeking overseas education, forging scholarship award letters and demanding upfront deposits for tuition or financial proof accounts.
howItWorks: Tiep can hoc sinh, phu huynh qua cac hoi thao du hoc online hoac nhom luyen thi IELTS.
Thong bao ho so cua hoc sinh xuat sac trung hoc bong 80% - 100% cua truong dai hoc tai Uc/Canada.
Gui thu trung tuyen (Letter of Offer) bang tieng Anh co chu ky va logo truong gia mao.
Yeu cau phu huynh chuyen 50 - 200 million VND vao "Tai khoan uy thac visa" de giu suat hoc bong truoc han chot.
Sau khi nhan tien, trung tam ao bien mat khong dau vet.
warningSigns: Duoc cap hoc bong gia tri cao qua de dang ma khong can trai qua phong van hay yeu cau chung chi ngoai ngu khat khe.
Yeu cau nop tien coc hoc bong qua so tài khoản ca nhan tai Viet Nam.
Email gui thu trung tuyen dung ten mien mien phi (@gmail.com, @yahoo.com) thay vi ten mien truong dai hoc (`.edu`, `.edu.au`).
redFlags: Thuc ep nop tien trong vong 24 - 48 gio neu khong se chuyen hoc bong cho ung vien khac.
psychologicalTactics: Danh vao niem tu hao va uoc mo du hoc nuoc ngoai cua hoc sinh va phu huynh.
Tao ap luc thoi han giu cho de phu huynh khong kip lien he xac minh voi truong.
tactics: Lam gia thu trung tuyen dai hoc
Cam ket hoc bong bao do
Thu phi bao chung tai chinh ao
whatScammersAskFor: Chuyen tien coc giu suat hoc bong, phi bao hiem du hoc sinh, phi chung minh tai chinh tu 50 million den 300 million VND.
howToVerify: Kiem tra dia chi email nguoi gui: Phai co duoi ten mien chinh thuc cua truong (VD: `@sydney.edu.au`, `@harvard.edu`).
Gui email truc tiep vao hom thu tuyen sinh (Admissions Office) tren website chinh thuc cua truong de xác minh.
countermeasures: Chi lam viec voi cac cong ty tu van du hoc co phap nhan va giay phep hoat dong giao duc ro rang.
whatToDoIfTargeted: Dung giao dich, lien he truc tiep voi truong dai hoc o nuoc ngoai de check.
whatToDoIfCompromised: Bao cao cho co quan police kinh te kem toan bo thu tu va sao ke chuyển tiền.
howItWorks_en: Victims receive fake email notifications or social media ads offering 100% full scholarships to top US, UK, or Australian universities.
Scammers organize fake online consultation webinars.
They demand immediate deposit payments (thousands of USD) to hold scholarship spots or prove financial capability.
After receiving payment, scammers cut off contact.
warningSigns_en: Scholarship offers granted without formal academic application, essays, or language tests.
Email sender addresses using free domains (gmail.com, yahoo.com) instead of official university domains (.edu, .ac.uk).
Demanding upfront seat reservation fees transferred to private bank accounts.
whatScammersAskFor_en: Upfront deposit fees for seat reservation, application processing, or visa guarantee.
Academic transcripts, passport scans, and family financial records.
howToVerify_en: Verify scholarship announcements directly on official university portals.
Check education consultancy accreditation with the Ministry of Education and Training (MOET).
countermeasures_en: Never pay money to hold a scholarship spot without official university confirmation.
Communicate strictly through official university domain emails.
whatToDoIfTargeted_en: Contact the university admissions office directly to verify the scholarship offer.
Refuse any deposit demands sent via personal bank accounts.
whatToDoIfCompromised_en: Report the fraud to police cybercrime divisions.
Notify official educational authorities.

title: 29. Mạo Danh Giáo Viên / Bệnh Viện Báo 'Con Đang Cấp Cứu' Giục Chuyển Tiền Mổ Gấp
title_en: 29. Emergency Hospital Call Scam Demanding Immediate Surgery Deposits for Child
category: Mạo danh & Tống tiền khẩn cấp
shortDescription: Gọi điện thoại cho phụ huynh thông báo con bị ngã chấn thương sọ não đang ở phòng cấp cứu, ép chuyển ngay 20-50 triệu vào tài khoản bác sĩ để mổ gấp.
shortDescription_en: Impersonating teachers or hospital emergency doctors, calling parents to report their child suffered severe head trauma and needs immediate money for surgery.
whatIsIt: Thủ đoạn lừa đảo tàn nhẫn nhắm vào phụ huynh học sinh. Kẻ gian gọi điện thông báo con bị tai nạn chấn thương sọ não đang ở phòng cấp cứu, ép chuyển tiền mổ gấp.
whatIsIt_en: Scammers exploit terrifying emergency scenarios, calling parents to claim their child had a severe school accident and requires urgent surgery deposits to save their life.
howItWorks: Thu thap thong tin ho ten phu huynh, ten con, ten truong hoc va lop hoc cua con.
Goi dien trong gio con dang hoc tren lop (luc nay phu huynh khong the goi dien cho con vi con khong dung dien thoai trong gio hoc).
Dau day ben kia co tieng coi hu cuu thuong, tieng bac si quat thao tao hien truong gia cap cuu.
Tu xung bac si truong khoa cap cuu yeu cau chuyen ngay 20-50 million vao tài khoản vien phi de ky lenh mo gap.
warningSigns: Benh vien KHONG BAO GIO tu choi cap cuu benh nhan vi chua nop tien tam ung qua chuyển khoản ngân hàng ca nhan.
Nguoi goi thuc ep chuyển tiền ngay lap tuc, de doa "cham 5 phut la con nguy hiem tinh mang".
So tài khoản nhan vien phi la tài khoản ca nhan chu khong phai tài khoản chinh thuc cua benh vien.
redFlags: Tu choi cho phu huynh nghe may cua giao vien chu nhiem voi ly do "co giao dang lam viec voi police".
psychologicalTactics: Tan cong truc dien vao diem yeu lon nhat cua cha me: Tinh mang va su an nguy cua con cai.
Tao cu soc hoang loan cuc do khien phu huynh mat hoan toan kha nang tu duy logic.
tactics: Gay hoang so tot do
Tao am thanh gia hien truong cap cuu
Loi dung gio hoc cua con
whatScammersAskFor: Chuyen tien tam ung vien phi, tien mo khan cap tu 20 million den 100 million VND.
howToVerify: Quy tac vang: Giu giữ bình tĩnh, dap may va goi ngay cho GIAO VIEN CHU NHIEM hoac SO DIEN THOAI NHA TRUONG cua con.
Goi truc tiep vao tong dai benh vien duoc nhac ten de check xem co benh nhan ten con nhap vien khong.
Cac benh vien luon uu tien cuu chua tinh mang benh nhan truoc, lam thu tuc tai chinh sau.
countermeasures: Luu san so dien thoai giao vien chu nhiem, giam thi va ban giam hieu nha truong trong danh ba.
Dan do con ve cac tinh huong an toan tai truong hoc.
whatToDoIfTargeted: Binh tinh dap may, goi cho nha truong check.
whatToDoIfCompromised: Bao ngay cho bank chuyển tiền va co quan police gan nhat.
howItWorks_en: Parents receive frantic phone calls claiming to be from a hospital doctor or school teacher.
The caller states the child fell at school, suffered critical brain injury, and is in the emergency room.
They demand immediate transfer of 20M to 50M VND to a doctor's personal bank account to initiate life-saving surgery.
Panicking parents transfer money immediately without double-checking.
warningSigns_en: Caller pressures immediate money transfer before hospital treatment can begin.
Requests transfer to personal bank accounts rather than hospital accounting departments.
Reluctance to allow parents to speak with homeroom teachers or school principals.
whatScammersAskFor_en: Immediate money transfers for emergency surgery or medical supplies.
howToVerify_en: Hospitals in Vietnam NEVER refuse life-saving emergency care for accident victims while waiting for phone bank transfers.
Call homeroom teachers, school administrators, or hospital hotlines directly to verify.
countermeasures_en: Stay calm and verify the child's whereabouts with the school before transferring any money.
Save verified phone numbers of school teachers and administrators.
whatToDoIfTargeted_en: Hang up and immediately call the homeroom teacher or school office.
Do not transfer money under panic pressure.
whatToDoIfCompromised_en: Call bank hotline instantly to request transaction hold.
File an urgent police report.

title: 30. Lừa Mua Bán Vé Máy Bay / Vé Xem Concert Âm Nhạc Ảo (Pass Vé Ảo)
title_en: 30. Fake Concert & Flight Ticket Reselling Fraud (Pass Ticket Scam)
category: Thương mại & Vé sự kiện ảo
shortDescription: Lập tài khoản 'pass vé' concert ca sĩ nổi tiếng hoặc vé máy bay Tết giá rẻ, nhận tiền chuyển khoản xong gửi mã vé giả hoặc chặn tài khoản.
shortDescription_en: Advertising resold concert tickets (Blackpink, Taylor Swift) or cheap airline tickets online, taking money from multiple buyers using forged QR tickets.
whatIsIt: Kẻ lừa đảo lợi dụng các sự kiện âm nhạc cháy vé (concert ca sĩ nổi tiếng) hoặc vé máy bay Tết giá rẻ, đăng bài 'pass vé', nhận tiền chuyển khoản xong gửi mã vé giả hoặc chặn tài khoản.
whatIsIt_en: Scammers post ads on social media offering to resell sold-out concert tickets or cheap flight tickets, selling duplicate fake e-tickets to multiple unsuspecting buyers.
howItWorks: Dang bai trong cac nhom fan ham mo: "Minh ban viec dot xuat can pass lai 2 ve VIP concert gia goc".
Gui anh chup man hinh email xac nhan mua ve, anh can cuoc cong dan chinh chu (thuc chat la CCCD an cap cua nguoi khac) de tao uy tin.
Yeu cau nguoi mua chuyển khoản ngân hàng 100% tien ve de "doi thong tin nguoi nhan ve tren he thong Ticketbox".
Nhan tien xong, doi tuong xoa bai viet, chan tài khoản Facebook/Zalo cua nguoi mua.
Hoac gui ma QR ve gia, khi nguoi mua den cong su kien quet ma thi he thong bao ve gia hoac ve da duoc su dung.
warningSigns: Ban ve su kien hot dang chay ve voi gia re hoac gia goc ma khong doi tien chenh lech.
Tu choi giao dich truc tiep mat doi mat hoac tu choi su dung dich vu trung gian uy tin.
Hoi thuc chuyển khoản ngân hàng nhanh vi "dang co nhieu nguoi hoi mua cung luc".
redFlags: Tai khoan mang xa hoi moi tao, khong co tuong tac that trong cong VND fan.
So tài khoản ngân hàng khong trung ten voi Can cuoc cong dan cung cap.
psychologicalTactics: Danh vao tam ly hao huc, cuong nhiet muon gap than tuong cua nguoi ham mo tre tuoi.
Tao ap luc khan hiem ve (ve sap ban cho nguoi khac neu khong chot trong 5 phut).
tactics: Pass ve gia
Tao long tin bang CCCD an cap
Mot ve ban cho hang chuc nguoi
whatScammersAskFor: Chuyen tien mua ve may bay hoac ve concert tu 1 million den hang chuc million VND.
howToVerify: Chi mua ve qua cac kenh phan phoi chinh thuc cua ban to chuc (Ticketbox, dai ly ve may bay chinh hang).
Neu mua lai ve: Bat buoc giao dich truc tiep gap mat hoac dung dich vu trung gian co bao hiem tien gui.
countermeasures: Khong tin cac hinh anh chup CCCD gui qua mang vi co the la giay to bi danh cap.
Kiem tra uy tin nguoi ban trong cac nhom cong VND truoc khi giao dich.
whatToDoIfTargeted: Tu choi chuyển tiền neu khong duoc giao dich truc tiep.
whatToDoIfCompromised: Dang bai canh bao thong tin tài khoản ke lua dao len cac hoi nhom fan de ngan chan them nan nhan.
Trinh bao police ve hanh vi lua dao chiem doat tai san.
howItWorks_en: Scammers post in ticket exchange groups offering sold-out concert tickets at attractive prices.
They provide fake ID photos or booking receipts to build trust.
Buyers transfer money via bank transfer.
Scammers send invalid/duplicate QR code tickets or block buyers immediately after receiving payment.
warningSigns_en: Sellers refusing ticket transaction processing through official ticket ticketing platforms.
Unusually low prices for high-demand sold-out events.
Seller profile created recently with minimal real social interaction.
whatScammersAskFor_en: Full or partial money transfers for ticket booking.
Personal buyer details for ticket re-issuance.
howToVerify_en: Use official ticket resale partners or escrow services with buyer protection guarantees.
Verify airline ticket codes directly on official airline websites (Manage Booking).
countermeasures_en: Avoid purchasing high-value tickets from unverified individuals on social media.
Insist on face-to-face transactions or official ticketing transfer mechanisms.
whatToDoIfTargeted_en: Refuse unverified bank transfers for tickets.
Report scammer accounts to ticket exchange group admins.
whatToDoIfCompromised_en: Save transaction receipts, chat transcripts, and seller bank details.
Report the fraud to law enforcement.
